result.summary: Kessler Traders GmbH shows a clear improvement in settlement behavior: days-late fell from 46 and 55 days on the two oldest settled invoices to just 10 days on the most recent one. However, the current open invoice (INV001567, €86,900) is already 25 days past due, signaling a possible reversal of that improving trend. Total open exposure of €189,100 remains well within the single €430,000 credit line held on this buyer, but the line has not been reviewed since October 2024.
concerns: Most recent open invoice (INV001567) is 25 days past due, breaking the recent improving pattern
Two of three settled invoices were paid 46-55 days late, indicating historically weak discipline against 45-day terms
Credit limit review is over a year old (last reviewed 2024-10-24) and should be refreshed given payment volatility
Only three settled invoices available, limiting confidence in the trend assessment
